title: Communal street landscaped and lit
text: C1.2.3 Where provided, the communal street (including any adjoining setbacks) is to be landscaped and provided with adequate lighting to pathways and vehicle access areas.

replaces.note: C2.1(iv) lighting and landscaping of common property
communal open space no longer mentioned

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: diverges: a different provision under the same number. Chapter 3 C1.2.3 (p11) is communal street landscaping and lighting; Chapter 2 C1.2.3 is the street setback tree provision, which is C1.2.4 here. Applies only where a communal street is provided (rule condition). 'Adequate' lighting is stated by the applicant, not measured. C3.7.14 cross-refers to 'C1.3.3', which does not exist; it should be C1.2.3 (ch3-011).
